Unit testing is a method used to test individual components of your code in isolation to ensure they work as expected.
Why is it Important?
1️⃣ Detects issues at the component level before integrating them into larger systems.
2️⃣ Ensures functionality, boosting the reliability of your pipelines.
3️⃣ Prevents breaking changes during updates by acting as a safety net.
4️⃣ Encourages confident code modifications without fear of introducing errors.
How to Implement It?
Learn step-by-step implementation with practical examples in Databricks.
